import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Written on the Wall II - Conjecture 13

*Reference:*
[E. DeLaVina, Written on the Wall II, Conjectures of Graffiti.pc](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)
-/


namespace WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture13

open SimpleGraph

variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nontrivial α]

/--
WOWII [Conjecture 13](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)

For a simple connected graph `G`, the size `b(G)` of a largest induced bipartite subgraph
satisfies `b(G) ≥ diam(G) + max_{v ∈ V} l(v) - 1`, where `diam(G)` is the diameter
of `G` and `l(v) = indepNeighborsCard G v` is the independence number of the
neighbourhood of `v`.
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 5]
theorem conjecture13 (G : SimpleGraph α) (h : G.Connected) :
    letI maxL := (Finset.univ.image (fun v => indepNeighborsCard G v)).max' (by simp)
    (G.diam : ℝ) + (maxL : ℝ) - 1 ≤ b G := by
  sorry

-- Sanity checks

/-- The largest induced bipartite subgraph invariant `b G` is nonneg for any graph. -/
@[category test, AMS 5]
example (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 3)) : 0 ≤ b G := Nat.cast_nonneg _

/-- In `K₂`, all vertices have degree 1, so `indepNeighborsCard` at vertex 0 is 0
(the neighbourhood of 0 consists of only vertex 1, which has no independent edges). -/
@[category test, AMS 5]
example : (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 2)).maxDegree = 1 := by decide +native

end WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture13

findings.description: The docstring of the anonymous K₂ sanity check (lines 53–54) incorrectly says that `indepNeighborsCard` at vertex 0 is 0 because its neighbourhood has no independent edges. Independence counts vertices, not edges: the singleton neighbourhood has independence number 1. I proved `indepNeighborsCard (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 2)) 0 = 1` in Lean without using the conjecture. The actual example on line 56 states the correct, different fact `maxDegree = 1`; the main theorem is unaffected.
findings.source_evidence: The source glossary, `wowIIdefs.js`, definition 4 defines local independence as “The independence number of the subgraph induced by the neighbors of vertex v.” Definition 5 defines independence number as “The maximum number of vertices such that no two are adjacent.” Read at http://web.archive.org/web/20260723211215/http://cms.uhd.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/wowIIdefs.js.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the comment with “In K₂, the maximum degree is 1.” If a local-independence sanity check is intended instead, correct the comment and change the example to `indepNeighborsCard (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 2)) 0 = 1`.

reformulations.difference: The Lean statement assumes `[Nontrivial α]`, while the source states the bound for simple connected graphs without explicitly excluding the one-vertex graph.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: A connected graph is nonempty. The only excluded finite connected graph is therefore K₁, whose diameter and maximum local independence number are both 0. Its left-hand side is −1, so the inequality follows from nonnegativity of b (indeed b(K₁)=1). Thus the universal statement with the nontriviality restriction is equivalent to the unrestricted connected-graph statement. This equivalence was proved, uniformly in the vertex-type universe, as `Review.connected_iff_nontrivial` in /workspace/review/equivalence.lean.

sources_consulted: E. DeLaVina, Written on the Wall II, cited index: https://web.archive.org/web/20260807053017id_/http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/
Source glossary, definitions 4, 5, 14, 15, and Conjecture 13 bibliography: http://web.archive.org/web/20260723211215/http://cms.uhd.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/wowIIdefs.js
review.notes: The main theorem faithfully states the source's bound. The source marks Conjecture 13 “T” and credits DeLaVina and Waller (2004), agreeing with `research solved`. Both actual sanity-check statements are correct. Checked finiteness/nonemptiness of the maxima, the diameter's default-value cases, induced bipartiteness, and real-number coercions. Independent Lean experiments confirmed the K₂ docstring error and found no counterexamples among all connected graphs on up to five vertices. The live website timed out, so the author's archived pages were used. No repository files were edited.
